source: Original full-ramification cyclotomic phase samples with integer-embedded secret, fixed prime and IID uniform native ring-vector labels.

local_results.full_source: Public integral trace coordinates give IID nonzero phase-frequency vectors over Zq. General ring-secret scope is explicitly excluded.
local_results.known_reduction: Charged fresh binary-to-native one-hot and native-to-binary projections conform to the existing DCP/CCP reduction; no novelty claimed.
local_results.reference: Exact public suffix counts, rank/unrank and known rank-range erasure implement the optimal covariant full-secret measurement in bounded dense replay.
local_results.information: For N=q^n,D=3^m, mean optimal success is at least D/(D+N-1). At m=n*log3(q)+4 it exceeds approximately0.9878.
local_results.cost: This explicit DP stores at least N*D/(D+N-1) final entries on average. This is not a universal decoder runtime or memory lower bound.
local_results.target: A genuinely efficient implicit receiver, charged transversal construction, source transformation or different reduction; no uniform fiber sampler is imposed as the only possible route.

proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-SOURCE: Prove the original source law with all native input consumption, filtering probabilities and correlations charged; exclude general ring secrets unless separately established.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-RECEIVER: Give an actual decoder or coherent instrument without free unknown-state inverses, phase evaluations, identical-state copies, table access or QRAM.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-COMPLEXITY: Account for growing n and logq, classical preprocessing, uniform quantum gate synthesis, precision and confidence amplification.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-SECRET: Recover all original secret digits, not only a residue or one conditional packet's observable parameter.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-BASELINE: Compare the same supplied-state access model with legal classical measurements and best applicable known quantum algorithms.
proof_obligations_for_next_candidate.PO-NOVELTY: Do not rename the existing DCP/CCP reduction, subset-sum measurement or information bound as a discovery; require literature comparison and independent review.

falsifiers: A polynomial decoder uses q^n count entries or hides coherent compilation of an exponential public table.
A source transformation requires repeated unknown copies or uncharged conditioning.
An algorithm measures the public fiber and then claims access to its lost relative secret phase.
A same-size finite field silently replaces a prime-power cyclic target.
Only low secret digits or ideal measurement success are demonstrated while full growing-parameter decoding remains absent.
The method is already supplied by the known reduction or matches a legal classical or known quantum baseline.
next_experiment: Test a mathematically specified implicit high-rank receiver or reduction against this full-source contract; deprioritize further ideal-PGM and tiny-table benchmarks.
